div.div: دَابَّةٌ مَقْشُوطٌ عَنْهَا [for مَقْشُوط عَنْهَا الجُلُّ] and ↓ مُقَشَّطٌ [A beast of carriage having its housing, or covering, removed from it]. (TA.) You say also, ↓ رَجُلٌ مُقَشَّطٌ , meaning A man spoiled, despoiled, or plundered. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
